description: Search the web without prompt injection: one call runs a web search, then reads the top results (default 3) as clean Markdown with hidden text and prompt injections removed. Returns ranked sources (title, URL), each page's clean text and a per-page injection flag. Search results by You.com. Paid x402 $0.02 USDC on Base per search, flat; failures (no results, nothing readable) are not charged.

max_chars.description: Max characters of clean text per page (default 8000)

read_top.description: How many top results to read and clean (default 3)

name: saferead_search
